Maya S.: FYI NovaSoft reports ~128k objects in prefix nova-prod/2025-07-10 that had TTL retroactively set to 30d but many remain visible after expiry. They provided a sample ID and say delete API returns 200 yet items still show in UI and search.
Liam R.: ack, bumping to this thread. thread_ts=1993456789
Maya S.: Sample object: obj_az3F9q. Storage list headers: "x-retention-ttl: 2592000", "x-retention-applied-at: 1689000000". Customer exported audit logs and we see a gap for delete events in window 1689000500-1689004000.
Jason K.: can you paste that audit export snippet? any worker logs?
Maya S.: pasted. They also said they used BYOK (customer CMK in HSM).
retention-metrics-bot: deletion_queue_depth=15432
retention-metrics-bot: delete_worker_errors(1h)=43; kms_decrypt_errors(1h)=37
Emma T.: I'm seeing a big backlog. Possible causes: backfill triggered by retroactive TTL, KMS throttling from HSM, or workers deferring on AccessDenied. Pulling delete-worker logs now.
delete-bot: retention-backfill detected for prefix nova-prod/2025-07-10; candidates=128432
Jason K.: logs from delete-worker-3 show rewrap attempts failed with ThrottlingException then AccessDenied, and worker marked items deferred (no final delete audit event). That would explain missing audit entries.
Emma T.: excerpt from delete-worker-3 logs:
```
2025-07-10T12:05:03Z delete_worker[3]: enqueue_delete(obj_az3F9q) -> persist ok
2025-07-10T12:05:07Z delete_worker[3]: rewrap_metadata(obj_az3F9q) -> KMS::ThrottlingException
2025-07-10T12:05:07Z delete_worker[3]: rewrap failed, retrying
2025-07-10T12:06:12Z delete_worker[3]: rewrap_metadata(obj_az3F9q) -> AccessDenied
2025-07-10T12:06:12Z delete_worker[3]: mark as deferred for manual rewrap
```
Jason K.: AccessDenied on a CMK-backed rewrap is concerning. Could be HSM-side rate limits or a temporary policy change on the key.
kms-ops-bot: key_id=kt-54ef last_rotate=1688999900 rotate_in_progress=false; throttle_spike=1689000280-1689000950
Maya S.: customer confirms they did not rotate the key during that window but their HSM provider shows a throttle spike. They authorized us to coordinate with their key-admin.
Chloe L. (Legal): if audit entries are missing this needs a preserved forensics bundle immediately. Do not purge anything until legal confirms.
Liam R.: remediation options:
- Hot: run SRE-assisted manual rewrap+delete for affected prefix with elevated retries and bypass-backoff (requires security signoff). Produces audit events.
- Warm: scale delete-workers and let backlog drain after KMS throttle subsides (ETA dependent on rewrap throughput).
Emma T.: throughput calc: with successful rewraps we do ~200 deletes/s, but with rewraps hitting KMS and retries throughput falls to ~8-12/s. For current 15k queue depth conservative ETA ~25-35 minutes once KMS stable. Full prefix (~128k) longer.
Jason K.: action items:
- @Liam R. open P1 with SRE to temporarily increase concurrency and relax backoff for this backfill. owner: Liam. ETA 30m.
- @Emma T. pull KMS call logs 1689000000-1689005000 and share with security + customer key-admin. owner: Emma. ETA 45m.
- @Maya S. request full object id list from customer and permission to run manual purge for a sample subset and to coordinate with their key-admin. owner: Maya. ETA 20m.
- @Chloe L. preserve legal bundle and draft notice template for compliance once timeline is ready. owner: Chloe. ETA 2h.
Emma T.: KMS logs exported: lots of ThrottlingException entries from the IP pool used by backfill-runner; small window of AccessDenied at 1689000590-1689000700. Sharing in #security.
Maya S.: customer ok to let us run a manual purge on a small sample if we provide proof of deletion and audit events. They also offered to temporarily increase HSM request quotas with their provider.
Jason K.: SRE manual command (SRE-only, sec approval required):
```
# manual rewrap and delete for prefix (SRE + sec approval)
rbctl rewrap --prefix nova-prod/2025-07-10 --concurrency 8 --bypass-backoff --dry-run false
rbctl purge --prefix nova-prod/2025-07-10 --confirm
```
Liam R.: note bypass-backoff will increase KMS pressure; only use with customer consent and HSM quota raised.
Maya S.: I've asked customer for key-admin contact and to confirm HSM quota bump. Posting updates here.
Chloe L. (Legal): ensure all artifacts (logs, audit export, KMS responses, timestamps of TTL change) are snapshotted and uploaded to the legal case. Do not delete.
Jason K.: once manual purge runs we'll generate an audit bundle (rewrap attempts, delete events, KMS responses) to attach to the support ticket and share with customer.
Maya S.: thanks team. will update when I have permission and contact info. :pray:
